name: notes
description: Keep short freeform notes that outlive a conversation. This is the only record of them: list it to answer any question about what has been noted, rather than answering from the conversation. Listing returns this conversation's notes; pass session:"all" to reach every conversation's, or a session id for one.

session.description: Where to look, when listing. Omit for this conversation; "all" for every conversation; or a session id.
